basic_profile.bio: I recently got into drumming and Reddit, combining these two passions as I explore the world of music production. I'm based in Utrecht and love exploring local music scenes. I'm a university student studying sound engineering, which fuels my interest in recording techniques. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends, balancing my time between schoolwork and my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a sound engineering student, I have a foundational understanding of audio equipment and recording techniques. I mainly learn through my courses, online tutorials, and experimenting with my drum kit at home. My knowledge is growing, but I often seek advice from more experienced community members.
